the identification of intestinal dysbiosis markers in T2D, as well as the development of a microbiota signature, which could be used as a diagnostic and/or predictive marker for T2D development.

the gut microbiota dysbiosis, the increased plasma levels of IL-6 and the prevalence of Gram-negatives P. copri, and B. vulgas could be used as a predictive biomarker for T2D.

the intestinal dysbioses in the gut microbiome of T2D patients can be used as biomarkers for the early detection and diagnosis of this disease.
